quests.title: Reunite, My Shroom Buddies!

dialogue.t: Hey, a Fungus just floated past. Should it be doing that?
Normally, it's pretty dangerous to have Fungi wandering around the city, right? Unless we're talking about the special cases, the super well-behaved ones that have undergone training...
Now that Paimon thinks about it... Why does this feel so familiar? Haven't we been through something similar before?
That's right! It's Bongo-Head! The Fungi friend we met back in Sumeru!
Woahhh! It's been so, so long since we last saw it! Come on, let's go say hi!
Hmm? Looks like I don't need to leave a message at the Adventurers' Guild. Fate will always bring us back together...
We meet again, Golden Comet, Silver Companion. It's been a long time.
You're both so radiant and full of life. It feels as though no time has passed at all.

dialogue.sit: Though I can't quite remember... Hello to you both!

dialogue.t: It's really you, Haniyyah and Bongo-Head!
No wonder that message felt so familiar... Guess that means the bond between Paimon and Bongo-Head is still as strong as ever!
I imagined many different ways we might reunite. A grand feast, or a creative welcome ceremony, something that would give you a huge surprise.
But in the end, they all felt a little too formal. You've been busy, and I was worried that taking up too much of your time might cause you trouble.
Besides, our Fungi friends prefer a calm and peaceful environment these days. So, let's keep it simple and reunite in a manner that is both relaxed and easygoing.
That's right! The prose that Haniyyah's been reading really paid off. A calm state of mind does wonders for our lives, after all!
At the end of the day, carefree chitchat like this is the greatest joy of all.
Souka's here too! There's also Kindlejoy, and... Who's this?
This is my very own Fungi friend, Stormstress! You and Bongo-Head knocked us out back in the round of 32.
Ehehe, you remember it so well...

dialogue.sit: It's all starting to come back to me now...
The warm, welcoming atmosphere is helping me relax...

dialogue.t: Anyway, as you can see, dear big shots, we no longer need the chains of dates or places for our next meeting...
Haniyyah and I have purchased this commercial district and transformed it into the Lil' Fungi Playground!
Wait, so you're saying these facilities here aren't rented for the new tabletop game, but...
You've got it. From now on, we'll be living in Bayda Harbor and promoting the Fungus-themed tabletop game, as well as sharing our theories on communicating with animals.
Feel free to drop by and play with the Fungi friends whenever you have time!

dialogue.sit: We can see each other all the time now!

dialogue.t: Oh my goodness! This is easily one of the best things Paimon's heard all day!
After the first Fungi Tournament, Paimon thought of sooo many ideas for playing together with Bongo-Head. Now we can finally make them all happen!
Too bad we didn't prepare any treats for the Fungi friends... How amazing would it be if we could cuddle up with them and enjoy a table full of delicious food!
No need to worry about that. In the process of refining On Fungi Communities, I've been conducting foundational research on the food that Fungi enjoy.
My goal is to identify ingredients that both Fungi and humans can eat, so our buddies don't have to live off every flavor of Marvelous Jelly all year long.
One day, I'll find the ingredients that satisfy both human and Fungi tastes, and design delicious dishes we can all enjoy together!
And when it comes to putting theory into practice, I'll be our master chef! Just in case Haniyyah ends up ruining our eleventh pot.
Sounds like the day we sit in a circle and share a meal with our Fungi friends isn't far off, right?

dialogue.sit: We'll be waiting for your good news, Haniyyah!
We can't wait for Souka's feast!

dialogue.t: In that case, please do come back and visit the Lil' Fungi Playground when you get the chance. We, and all our Fungi friends, will always be here.
Who knows? The surprise might arrive even sooner than you expect.

quests.description: You and Paimon run into some old friends and incredible companions at Bayda Harbor…
